Fifteen Arab and Islamic countries have welcomed the UK and Australia’s decision to impose sanctions on Israeli settlement activities in the occupied West Bank, which are illegal under international law. In a joint statement, their foreign ministers voiced support for all efforts to hold those responsible for settlements to account, including through sanctions on entities and individuals, citing the E1 settlement plan as an example. The ministers also welcomed the UK sanctions on an Israeli group that obstructs the delivery of humanitarian aid to Gaza.
